Question Choices: Today, a runner can run 300 meters in one minute. This is 150% of what they could run two years ago. How far could they run two years ago?
Hints: The known amount equals the decimal percentage times the unknown whole. Divide to find that whole.
Solution: Let W be the original whole. 150%=1.5, so 1.5×W=300. Divide: W=300÷1.5=200 meters in one minute. Check:200×1.5=300.

Question Choices: A student reads 240 pages per week now. This is 120% of how much they read last year. How many pages did they read per week last year?
Hints: The known amount equals the decimal percentage times the unknown whole. Divide to find that whole.
Solution: Let W be the original whole. 120%=1.2, so 1.2×W=240. Divide: W=240÷1.2=200 pages per week. Check:200×1.2=240.

Question Choices: Two classes took a math test. Class A: 16 out of 20 students passed. Class B: 27 out of 30 students passed. Which class had the higher passing percentage?
Hints: Calculate each part divided by its own whole before comparing percentages.
Solution: Class A:16/20×100%=80%. Class B:27/30×100%=90%. 90%>80%, so classBhas the higher passing percentage.
